entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I need to arrange a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. First, can I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Of course. The name is Sam Jones, and the email is sam.jones@email.com.

Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloBand. To understand how to best help, could you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a technical issue. The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracking, is simply not working. I've tried everything, but it also won't sync that data to the app. So the whole feature is basically broken.
I'm very sorry to hear that. It sounds frustrating when a key feature isn't performing correctly. You believe the sensor itself is defective?
Yes, I think it must be defective. I've had it for a few weeks and was hoping a software update might fix it, but no luck.
I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 22 days ago. One moment while I confirm our policy.
Okay. I know it's been a little while, so I'm open to discussing options. Perhaps a partial credit or a discount on a replacement?
No need for that, Sam. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's much simpler than I thought it would be. That's great news.

Absolutely. Since the item is defective, we'll get that processed for you right away. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for the inconvenience.
A full refund, a return label, and a credit? Wow. Thank you, Alex, that's excellent service. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome, Sam. We appreciate your business. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've made this very easy. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
